descriptionChirho: The proper name Elyashiv (אֶלְיָשִׁיב, 'God restores'), referring to several OT figures: most prominently the high priest during Nehemiah's time who rebuilt the Sheep Gate (Neh 3:1, 13:4–7), also a descendant of David (1 Chr 3:24), a priest in David's time (1 Chr 24:12), and post-exilic returnees (Ezra 10:6, 24, 27, 36). The three clusters represent the bare name, conjunction-prefixed (וְאֶלְיָשִׁיב 'and Elyashiv'), and preposition-prefixed (לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב 'to/for Elyashiv'). Translations are consistent: spa Eliasib, hin एल्याशीब, arb أَلْيَاشِيبُ, kor 엘리아십, swa Eliashibu.
